amends_note: v1.0.0 is not edited. Controls named here are ADDED or RE-POINTED; every other control of v1.0.0 stands.

RE_POINTED_CONTROLS.fact_at_feb84915: The refusal of a consumer argv carrying the value had NO test anywhere; mutant M07 survived the suite (NB-1).
Neither 'process.env is never written by the delivery path' nor the ambient-value refusal had a test; mutants M06 and M08 survived (NB-1).
Asserted a non-zero count of consumers only.

positive_controls_added.description: PLATFORM_INDEPENDENT. The byte codec agrees with Node's on every padding case and refuses malformed input.
PLATFORM_INDEPENDENT. A clean, fully observed run derives OBS0, NP10, RC3 and RC7 PASSED; governedRepresentations returns exactly raw and base64.
PLATFORM_DEPENDENT, WINDOWS. OBS0: the observer finds the injected fixture in both representations in both argv and environment block, every run.
PLATFORM_DEPENDENT, WINDOWS. B1: the launcher is attached to a console AND a real console-less process is reported unattached.
PLATFORM_DEPENDENT, WINDOWS. RC5: kill path leaves no live holder; a killed depositor's entry survives and is recovered by the bounded sweep.

negative_controls_added.description: The bridge argv is exactly bridgeArgv() and carries no representation of the value; its environment carries neither the delivery variable nor an unrelated process variable.
The consumer is spawned with windowsHide false and not detached; its argv carries no representation of the value; process.env receives no write or delete during delivery, observed by a Proxy.
A launcher with no console is refused before the vault is read; only the console op reaches the bridge.
The recovery sweep refuses every prefix outside the sentinel namespace without starting a bridge.
The bridge contains no Add-Type and binds its entry points with Reflection.Emit.

mutation_controls_added.description: B-1 REGRESSION — any process under a delivered consumer that carries the variable, INCLUDING conhost.exe, or whose block cannot be read, fails RC7; reintroducing a name exemption goes RED.
ZERO SUBJECTS — no delivered consumer, too few bridges, or an unobserved tree yields NOT_RUN, never PASSED.
BLIND OBSERVER — a missing or partial fixture detection makes RC3, NP10 and RC7 NOT_RUN.
ZEROING RACE — the fake pipe copies bytes at flush time, so zeroing before the flush callback delivers zeros and goes RED.
